description: MCP Skills extension (SEP-2640) for the .NET Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK
Shared request/response contracts for the PayKit payments API (used by PayKit.Client).

Client for the PayKit payments API: check entitlements, verify Google Play purchases, restore purchases, spend virtual currency (on-device), plus a server client and webhook signature verification for app backends.

Google Play Billing for .NET MAUI apps backed by the PayKit payments API: load paywall offerings with localized Play prices, purchase in one call (Play sheet → server verification → acknowledgement), restore purchases, check entitlements.
